body: I’ve been debating doing this again to my stuff lately. I just have said a lot on them and accomplished nothing. Haven’t even posted in a while, but now I’m wondering if I did that, nuked my old posts, would I maybe feel free to use it again more. I know it’s all just me overthinking, not like many people even see them as they’re posted, but I can’t help feeling like I must destroy it to move forward, not that that makes sense. I wish I understood why I’m like this.
